subject: [PATCH v4 02/19] selftests/mm: skip collapse_compound_extreme() where the PMD is too large

reviews.author: Lorenzo Stoakes (ARM)
reviews.summary: Acknowledged the issue with PMD size assumptions on architectures with 64 KiB page sizes and agreed that skipping the test case is sensible.

2026-08-15.patch_summary: This patch series introduces a new selftest to verify the functionality of khugepaged, specifically testing its ability to handle large pages. The test case in question, collapse_compound_extreme(), is modified to skip running when the PMD size exceeds 32M, as it causes allocation failures on certain architectures.
